---
title: Chicken Liver Pâté
id: MAR-0057
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 15
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 250 g chicken livers
- 200 g butter
- to taste juice of ½ orange (to taste)
- to taste salt (to taste)
## Method
1. Melt the butter in a bain-marie.
2. Cook the chicken livers in salted boiling water for 5 minutes, then drain and put them in the blender glass; pour in the butter and blend; add the orange juice, blending briefly again.
3. Pour the mixture into a pâté mold, level the surface and let it cool.
4. Cover the mold with plastic wrap, sealing it well, and put in the refrigerator for a few hours, until the pâté has set.
5. By decreasing or increasing the amount of butter you will get a softer or firmer pâté respectively.
